hook.say: Africa is far bigger than your map makes it look. Five duels, three seconds each. Wait for the last one!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Texas or Nigeria?
questions.fact: Nigeria is about a third bigger than Texas.
questions.sayAnswer: Nigeria! It is about a third bigger than Texas.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Madagascar or France?
questions.fact: Madagascar, a single island, is bigger than mainland France.
questions.sayAnswer: Madagascar! This single island is bigger than mainland France.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Mexico or DR Congo?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Mexico or the Democratic Republic of the Congo?
questions.fact: DR Congo is about 19% bigger than Mexico.
questions.sayAnswer: The D R Congo! It is about nineteen percent bigger than Mexico.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Ethiopia or Egypt?
questions.fact: Ethiopia is about 10% bigger than Egypt, and has more people too.
questions.sayAnswer: Ethiopia! It is about ten percent bigger than Egypt, and it has more people too.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Greenland or Algeria?
questions.fact: Algeria is 10% bigger. Flat maps blow Greenland up to Africa's size.
questions.sayAnswer: Algeria! It is ten percent bigger. Flat maps blow Greenland up until it looks as big as all of Africa.
